Title: Small-Animal Surgery and Imaging
Description: A sterile-capable surgical suite with stereotaxic instruments, anesthesia systems, surgical sterilization equipment, and a Pearl Trilogy small-animal imaging system.

Title: Histology
Description: A BSL-2-capable laboratory equipped with automated tissue processing, embedding, microtomy, and tissue preparation systems.

Title: Cellular and Molecular Analysis
Description: Advanced instrumentation including a Keyence fluorescence microscope, Wes Simple Western system, QuantStudio 6 Flex real-time PCR, cryostat, and access to confocal microscopy and other small instruments for protein and nucleic acid measurements.

Title: Behavioral Neuroscience
Description: Four dedicated testing rooms equipped for operant conditioning, drug self-administration, maze testing, motor coordination, learning, memory, and anxiety-related behavioral assessments, as well as computerized human participant survey and behavior testing and statistical software.

Title: Bedding & Water Station
Description: Automated bedding dispenser and water filling station.

Title: Cage Washer
Description: Cabinet cage washer with separate clean and dirty sides.

Title: Dry Ice Maker
Description: On-site dry ice production for sample handling and transport.

Title: Environmental Monitoring
Description: Automated environmental monitoring system with 24-hour monitoring for rodent circadian rhythm studies, with environmental temperature and humidity controls.

Title: Cold Storage
Description: Three freezers (including an ultra-low temperature freezer) and 2 refrigerators for sample storage.
